_description: Dialysis Order scenario — Portable Low Dialysate Dialysis variant, fully static. orderType is pinned to 'Portable Low Dialysate Dialysis' (the SECOND — and 'different' — value of the Dialysis Order Type select; the static baseline dialysis-order.scenario.json uses 'Conventional Dialysis') with modality 'Hemodialysis (HD)'. Every other field is a concrete option text from the staging modal, so this exercises the OTHER order-type branch deterministically (unlike hdf-dialysis-order.scenario.json, which pins the same order type but fills everything else DYNAMIC). Select values are the exact option texts rendered in the modal (e.g. 'AV-Fistula', '36.0°C', '1.6 m²'); concrete values are used (never 'Other') so no conditional other_* inputs are required.

_config._comment_targetPatient: The target patient identifier is NOT stored here — it is read from config/config.json (appointment.targetPatientIdentifier), the single source of truth shared by every appointment/order test.
_config._comment_orderType: orderType = 'Portable Low Dialysate Dialysis' — the other branch of the Dialysis Order Type select (the baseline scenario uses 'Conventional Dialysis'). The Portable branch renders its own field set (Mode, TPA, Dialysate Volume, Dialyzer Cartridge, electrolytes); the remaining fields exist as hidden controls in the modal DOM and are filled by option-text occurrence like the other scenarios.

_fields.additionalInformation: E2E test portable dialysis order — created by Playwright.
